description: This file is a Markdown document describing the 'Clock' class and its methods for time manipulation in a testing or simulation environment, likely part of an API documentation or developer guide.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: A class providing methods to manipulate and simulate time, including fast forwarding, installing fake timers, pausing, resuming, setting fixed or system time, tailored for various programming languages.

methods.name: Clock.fastForward
methods.description: Advance the clock forward by a specified amount of time, triggering due timers once.

methods.name: Clock.install
methods.description: Install fake time implementations for functions like Date, setTimeout, and others, with optional initial time. Supports multiple languages.

methods.name: Clock.runFor
methods.description: Advance the clock and fire all timers for the specified duration.

methods.name: Clock.pauseAt
methods.description: Advance the clock to a specific time and pause it, preventing timers from firing unless resumed.

methods.name: Clock.resume
methods.description: Resume the flow of time, allowing timers to fire normally after being paused.

methods.name: Clock.setFixedTime
methods.description: Set the current time to a fixed value, making Date.now() and new Date() return this time consistently.

methods.name: Clock.setSystemTime
methods.description: Change the system time without affecting timers, simulating time zone or system clock changes.
